description: Finds items by what they are for and how they look: category, purpose, layout, tags and description, best match first. Items that match every word come first; when none does, the closest ones follow, marked as such. Examples: "testimonials quotes", "founder about", "pricing table", "sign in form", "timeline career".

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 50. Default 15.

query.description: Words to look for, in English: the section type and what it should show, e.g. "pricing table", "testimonials quotes" or "hero with photo". Plurals and common synonyms match.

name: search_items
title: Search themes.dev UI
